ground.prompt:
Edit Image 1 (the current ground game art) with a restrained style adjustment. Image 2 is the older softer version, supplied only to guide a middle ground in line strength and color values. Keep the present pixel-art design and detail; do not redesign or copy Image 2 wholesale.
The current image is too dark and too boldly outlined. Lighten the material midtones moderately, about 12-15%, keeping natural moss greens, warm earth, wood, terracotta and stone. Reduce the visual weight of dark outlines by about half: finer medium-dark warm brown contours and subtler internal lines, instead of chunky near-black borders. Keep enough edge definition to match our characters, with readable soft stepped pixel shading. Preserve texture and clarity; avoid washed-out colors, blur, glow, a white veil, glossy rendering or photorealism.
Preserve the exact silhouette, camera angle, framing, proportions, ground/base alignment and composition of Image 1. No new objects, text, interface or watermark. Keep all paths, junctions, worn areas and cobbles in exactly the same positions. Remove the heavy dark tracing around dirt/grass transitions; let their edges merge naturally with sparse softer grass clusters. Reduce the contrast of grass clumps and cobble cracks. The ground should be calmer and lighter while still textured. One continuous opaque terrain painting with NO square grid, tile seams, checkerboard or repeating rectangular patches. No scenery, buildings, trees or furniture.
